text:
Palolem Beach is in Canacona in Kushavati district, Goa, India.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Canacona is a city in the South Goa district in the extreme south of Goa. It includes touristy beaches such as Palolem, Patnem and Agonda.
best_time: November to February (pleasant sunny days, gentle ocean breezes, calm swimming waters)
